info.title: Surfacer API
info.description: Use surf_key_ member keys as Bearer credentials through the web URL, or sign in for an opaque HttpOnly browser session. Browser sessions expire after eight hours or 30 minutes idle and are revoked on logout or web-process restart. JSON writes are capped at 32 KiB (session sign-in: 2 KiB). Request payload examples are in README.md.

browserSession.name: surfacer_session
browserSession.description: Opaque server-side session ID; never a workspace token or member API key.

get.description: Minimum role: viewer. This deployment contains one workspace. Scan snapshots include additive stage coverageStatus (finished, incomplete, unknown), issue and optional startedAt/finishedAt fields. coverage.http and coverage.detection contain finished/remaining counts when recorded; absent fields mean unknown for legacy runs. HTTP counts measure service origins; detection counts measure required service/template pairs for eligible services, not exhaustive asset coverage. coverage.serviceIssues contains up to 50 origin/reason records with serviceIssueCount for the total. Partial/failed scans include resume.fromStage, retainedStages, repeatedStages and checkpointPolicy. parentScanId links continued attempts. Existing execution status and progress semantics are unchanged. Webhook URLs and legacy webhook-creation audit destinations are masked for every role; member key hashes are never returned.

delete.description: Minimum role: owner. Removes records from active views, reports, metrics and MCP; retains internal history and append-only audit records. Each request is atomic and accepts 1–100 unique existing IDs. Already deleted IDs are safe to retry. Client bulk operations use multiple requests and may partially complete. Fresh observations in a later scan may make deleted observations visible again. This is not a storage/evidence purge or finding resolution. Only finished scans may be deleted. Active leases, observations, checkpoints and scheduling history are retained internally.

post.summary: Resume partial or failed scan from saved checkpoints
post.description: Minimum role: analyst. Creates a new queued run from the earliest incomplete stage; completed port batches, crawl seeds and confirmed detection services are retained when their upstream inputs remain valid. Rejects concurrent target scans. The restart stage uses the same server helper as the snapshot resume preview. The new run stores parentScanId and clears timestamps only for stages rerun. Authorization and availability are rechecked at execution time; the preview does not grant permission.

409.description: Scan not eligible or target already active

/mcp.description: Stateless MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint on the web service. Requires an active surf_key_ member key; browser sessions and bootstrap/service credentials are rejected. See docs/mcp.md. Internally forwarded to /api/mcp.

post.summary: MCP protocol requests and tool calls
post.description: Minimum role: viewer for discovery and reads; analyst or owner for start_scan, resume_scan, cancel_scan, and triage_finding. get_scan reads one scan; list tools support bounded pagination and applicable status/severity filters. 32 KiB request limit. API role and scan controls apply to each mutation.

200.description: MCP JSON-RPC response; schema/protocol failures return a JSON-RPC error and tool execution failures set result.isError

400.description: Invalid protocol message or unsupported protocol version

get.description: Minimum role: viewer. Returns webhook metadata with masked URL paths and query values for all roles, including owners. Use the saved ID for test and deletion.

401.description: Unauthorized

post.description: Minimum role: owner. Supports slack, discord, and generic formats; at most 32 webhooks. Requires a public HTTPS URL on port 443 without user credentials or fragments. Delivery validates every resolved IP at dial time and rejects redirects, private/loopback/link-local destinations and environment proxies. Existing unsafe destinations remain stored but cannot deliver. Creation returns a masked URL.

401.description: Unauthorized

delete.description: Minimum role: owner. Removes webhook by query parameter id.

post.summary: Dispatch a test payload to a webhook
post.description: Minimum role: owner. Waits up to five seconds outside the workspace lock for test delivery. Accepts a saved id or a public HTTPS url. A supplied but missing id returns 404 without URL fallback. Applies the same destination policy as normal delivery. Errors never include destination credentials.

post.description: Web service only. Accepts the workspace bootstrap token or an active member key. Replaces the supplied browser session. Cookie is HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict and Secure on HTTPS; lifetime is eight hours with a server-enforced 30-minute idle timeout. One web process supports up to 1,000 sessions. Existing credential cookies require fresh sign-in.

200.description: Session created; opaque surfacer_session cookie set

401.description: Invalid, expired or revoked credential

503.description: Authentication unavailable or session capacity reached

delete.description: Web service only. Revokes the supplied cookie session, aborts its active requests/streams, and clears the cookie. Does not revoke member API keys.
